15.text: But Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffereth him.

4.text: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

7.text: Jesus said unto him, Again it is written, Thou shalt not make trial of the Lord thy God.

10.text: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

17.text: From that time began Jesus to preach, and to say, Repent ye; for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.

19.text: And he saith unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you fishers of men.
